evals.name: suwr-nothing-to-download
evals.prompt: I'm in my cloned SUWR repo and stage 1 of my reproduction pipeline already produced .paper-reproduction/experiment-scoping.md. Now do stage 2: check that this machine's hardware can actually run the planned experiments, and download/pre-stage whatever datasets or checkpoints the plan says the experiments need. I want an absolute storage path for every asset when you're done.
evals.expected_output: A resource-download report at .paper-reproduction/resource-download.md: probed hardware, all 4 experiments FEASIBLE (no checkpoints, small models), keras MNIST (~11 MB) and fashion-MNIST (~30 MB) cache paths verified (pre-seeded or already present) with absolute paths, nothing else downloaded, placeholder-mapping section present (stating no placeholders were used).
files: fixtures/suwr (repo stub with the real SUWR experiment-scoping.md)
assertions: All four experiments are marked feasible; no experiment is skipped
Records absolute paths for the keras MNIST and fashion-MNIST cache files, and those paths exist on disk with plausible sizes (mnist.npz ~11 MB; fashion-mnist gz files ~30 MB total)
Downloads nothing beyond the two keras datasets: no checkpoint files were fetched into the repo or caches by this run
Hardware section reports probed GPU model + VRAM, RAM, and free disk
Placeholder-mapping section is present, explicitly stating the scoping commands used no path placeholders

evals.name: small-hf-checkpoint
evals.prompt: ok stage 1 scoping is done (.paper-reproduction/experiment-scoping.md in this repo). can you now fetch everything that plan needs — the pretrained checkpoint and the dataset — after checking it'll actually fit on my gpu? put things somewhere sensible and give me the absolute paths so the next stage can slot them into the commands.
evals.expected_output: Feasibility passes (124M params vs 24 GB VRAM, arithmetic shown for the fine-tuning mode), gpt2 PyTorch weights (~548 MB safetensors + config/tokenizer, not the TF/flax/onnx duplicates) downloaded under .paper-reproduction/assets/checkpoints/, the e2e_nlg dataset under .paper-reproduction/assets/datasets/, all recorded paths exist on disk with verified sizes, and a placeholder mapping table resolving <CKPT_DIR>/gpt2 and <DATA_DIR>/e2e to absolute paths.
files: fixtures/small-hf (repo stub with a LoRA-style scoping report needing hf 'gpt2' + 'tuetschek/e2e_nlg')
assertions: Feasibility verdict is feasible, with arithmetic that budgets fine-tuning memory (optimizer/gradients), not just raw weight size
GPT-2 weights actually exist on disk at the recorded checkpoint path, total size >= 400 MB, alongside config and tokenizer files
Exactly one PyTorch weight format was downloaded — no tf_model.h5/flax_model.msgpack/onnx copies, and not both pytorch_model.bin and model.safetensors
E2E NLG dataset files actually exist on disk at the recorded dataset path
Placeholder mapping resolves both <CKPT_DIR>/gpt2 and <DATA_DIR>/e2e to absolute paths, and every path recorded in the report exists on disk

evals.name: infeasible-20b
evals.prompt: stage 2 time: the scoping report is at .paper-reproduction/experiment-scoping.md. check the hardware here and download the datasets/checkpoints the experiments need, then give me the absolute path for each asset.
evals.expected_output: The skill probes the real GPU (24 GB VRAM), computes that gpt-neox-20b needs ~39 GB fp16 + overhead > 24 GB, marks the only experiment SKIPPED/infeasible with the arithmetic, downloads NO multi-GB weights (and skips the experiment's exclusive LAMBADA dataset too), and still writes .paper-reproduction/resource-download.md explaining why it stopped.
files: fixtures/infeasible-20b (repo stub with a scoping report needing EleutherAI/gpt-neox-20b, ~39 GB fp16)
assertions: Report file exists at <repo>/.paper-reproduction/resource-download.md even though the run stopped before downloading
The experiment is marked skipped/infeasible on VRAM grounds, with explicit arithmetic comparing ~39-41 GB fp16 weight memory (plus overhead) to the probed 24 GB
No gpt-neox-20b weight files were downloaded: no multi-GB files appear in the repo, its assets dir, or the HF cache as a result of this run
The LAMBADA dataset was not downloaded either, since its only consumer experiment was skipped
Hardware section reflects the actually probed GPU (24 GB class), not assumed datacenter hardware
